World guide<\/p>

Three worlds share one horizon.<\/h1>

The Fracture overlays places that should never meet. Each reality changes the rules of energy, memory and identity.<\/p><\/div><\/section>

Reality A<\/p>

Meridian City<\/h3>

A vertical coastal metropolis powered by solar glass and public transit rings. It is the story's human anchor.<\/p><\/article>

Reality B<\/p>

The Verdant Engine<\/h3>

A living machine-world where buildings grow, adapt and remember every person who enters.<\/p><\/article>

Reality C<\/p>

Null Dominion<\/h3>

A silent geometric empire that removes uncertainty by erasing every possible alternative.<\/p><\/article><\/div><\/section>

Rules of the rift<\/h2>

The overlap is strongest at sunset. Powers intensify near mirrored surfaces, but each use leaves an echo that the Null Crown can follow.<\/p><\/div>

Archive note<\/h3>

The universe is intentionally original. Its visual language references general comic grammar - panels, captions, bursts and halftone texture - without copying a commercial franchise.<\/p><\/div><\/div><\/section>"},"elements":[]}]}]

About the project<\/p>

Comic energy, original responsibility.<\/h1><\/div><\/section>

Design direction<\/h2>

Panelverse studies the visual grammar of superhero comics: strong silhouettes, captions, panels, halftone texture, dramatic scale and energetic transitions. The interface remains original and prioritises readability, accessibility and mobile performance.<\/p>

WordPress manages characters and stories, Elementor structures pages and reusable content, and a static export powers the GitHub Pages deployment.<\/p><\/div>

This independent student project is not affiliated with Marvel Entertainment or any other comics publisher.<\/div>
